notes.title: ✺Act 2 is on hiatus ✺
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! 

First of all, thank you for the reviews, critiques, and praise for 'Dark Light'! I truly didn't expect the reach the game has received, and I am eternally grateful to you, not only for the good parts but for the feedback that will help the game improve a lot. I'm here to announce that unfortunately the second Act will enter a hiatus of one month (at least), so we won't have very significant news during this period. 

As I've already said on my social media, my computer unexpectedly broke last month, which made continuing the game (and its updates) very difficult, and also forced me to reduce the frequency of my posts and illustrations. I contacted technical support, but in the end it will be necessary to buy a new computer, which was something unexpected, so I'm currently working and raising money for that. 

If you have an interest in helping, you can access my Patreon (which has exclusive extra content about the game, plus free doodles), ko-fi, or you can commission me for personalized orders.

[url=https://www.patreon.com/c/theusagygy]Patreon[/url]  |  [url=ko-fi.com/usagygy]ko-fi[/url]  |  [url=https://usagygy.wixsite.com/portfolio/services-4]Commissions[/url]

notes.title: 🦋 Act 2 is in production ! 🦋
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45227621/460588b9b7f249dbae0a176cb9b41e9899932b0c.png[/img]


Hello, surface people! I'm happy to announce that the Second Act of 'Dark Light' is officially in production! It’s a great honor to continue this story, and this is mainly thanks to your support—thank you so much for everything!  

Currently, we are working on:  
➜ In-game checkpoints (already implemented)  
➜ Scene optimizations  
➜ New translations (Spanish, French)  

Support us on Patreon and get early access to the second act and future games set in the Dark Light universe! [url=https://www.patreon.com/c/theusagygy]Click here![/url]  

✥ May Chaos guide you! ✥
